subject: English
passage:
The following text is from Titilayo Fashola's 2018 memoir The Architecture of Memory (originally written in Spanish and translated by Luka Marin). The narrator reflects on her time working at a community arts center in Mexico City.

I may be the most disorganized and impractical person you could imagine and, as my colleagues often reminded me, someone completely lacking in business sense—that is, before joining our center—but I did have the privilege of working alongside a truly gifted artist who possessed an extraordinary ability to transform ordinary materials into something beautiful. I spent countless hours in her studio. I observed her creative process. I watched how inspiration would suddenly ignite within her and take form, like a seed growing into a magnificent garden, before becoming reality.

©2018 by Luka Marin
prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: A person was fortunate enough to have found friendship despite her obvious professional limitations.
choices.B: An exceptionally creative person demonstrates modesty to avoid making others feel inadequate.
choices.C: A truly talented person allows creative projects to develop gradually before revealing them to others.
choices.D: A person values the substantial time she spent in the presence of someone she greatly respected.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer because it most accurately describes the main idea of the text: a person values the substantial time she spent in the presence of someone she greatly respected. The speaker says that she spent "countless hours" (extensive time) in the company of a "truly gifted artist" with "extraordinary ability." These phrases indicate the speaker's feelings of respect and appreciation.
